title: LockerPublicKeys
description: locker.public-keys@1: what anyone may read about a person's locker: the two public keys and the eight-word fingerprint. The fingerprint is the first eight bytes of SHA-256 over both public keys, read as eight words in two groups of four, and the signature proves the holder owns the signing key, so a person can compare the eight words out of band and a key change is visible.

fingerprint.description: Eight words, lower case, in two groups of four: sixty-four bits. Compare them out of band; a change means a changed key.

fingerprint_signature.description: The ECDSA signature over both public keys, base64. It proves the holder owns the signing key.
